owner_goal: Learn and later implement reliable user-sovereign insect-farm care, biofuel harvesting, inventory custody, and optional generator refueling for any observed household without interfering with normal gameplay.

ownership.existing_scene_and_lot: docs/ACQUISITION_ROUTING.md and current host scene/lot contracts

evidence.image_handling: Do not copy screenshot to public repository; preserve only nonpersonal menu observation notes.

5 houses as author's recommended throughput strategy, not requirement
two Bits and Pieces as generator refuel alternative
farm care includes separate hunger and health

Eco-Upgrade Parts made at Fabricator using 15 bits and 10 pieces
generators can use insect farm fuel

design_decisions: Separate insect farm health/feeding from collection, Sim pocket inventory, and generator fuel consumption; no one-step 'get fuel' assumption.
Discover N observed farm objects on the active lot, not a fixed number of houses. Five houses is a suggestion, not minimum.
Use current observed farm and portrait identities scoped to lot/scene revision; no name, pixel, house coordinates or old clicked object replay.
All insect care/harvest are physically queued/time gated candidates. Never classify as instant computer Order without observed per-effect proof.
Observe screenshot menu items as possible affordances only; visible text alone does not prove enabled action or actual completion.
Do not infer a daily clock based on wall-time; use in-game clock and last observed outcome, with 24h as a provisional observation hint.
Never perform Clean Out as routine maintenance. Treat as RESET_COLONY destructive with separate informed operator approval, safe backup and explicit observation.
Harvest product arbitration: biofuel versus cricket flour/beetle nuggets/grub meal on a farm may share cooldown; assume conflict until tested.
Fuel asset inventory is distinct from household Bits/Pieces resource and generator fuel tank. No synthetic conversion without proof.
No new process daemon, key hook, mouse controller or global override. Integrate later into existing game source/queue/lease.
Eco footprint impact sources disagree: keep UNKNOWN and test in isolated, controlled game before optimization.

proof_pipeline.P1: PASSIVE exact-build local scene: identify every farm/portrait/health/menu/clock, measure enabled states; no click
proof_pipeline.P2: OPERATOR_PERFORMS care and first controlled harvest; record queue, before/after counts, cooldown and one-farm output
proof_pipeline.P3: OPERATOR_PERFORMS optional generator refuel using one observed biofuel can, observe item consumption and generator level
proof_pipeline.P4: ONE_SUPERVISED_ADOPTED_QUEUE_EFFECT with explicit opt-in, one farm, no automated retry, human interruption test
proof_pipeline.P5: N-farm/multi-portrait cooperative scheduling with no player conflict, no dead colony, no duplicate harvest, exact game-build receipts
proof_pipeline.P6: OPT_IN_AUTONOMY_AFTER_OPERATOR_ACCEPTANCE only; eco impact experiment and tradeoffs measured separately

operator_handoff_questions_to_resolve_by: Is Collect Bio-Fuel enabled on the same farm/menu when Cricket Flour is offered?
Does choosing Bio-Fuel prevent Flour that day, and do different insect types alter harvest policy?
Where exactly does the resulting can land (selected Sim pocket, household inventory, alternate)? Exact menu and item text?
Is feed available as paid vs compost action, and how much improvement after Nurture?
How many game hours between eligible collections on this game version?
Does the household's generator accept a can directly, and through which exact visible menu?
How many fuel units/level increments per can; does consumption alter observed eco footprint?
Can you select another portrait to collect or does farm proximity/pathfinding change queue behavior?
Does Clean Out actually reset a colony on this installed patch (do not click to test without disposable test state)?
